title: The CEO’s Secret Wife
description: A contract marriage turns dangerous when hidden feelings become impossible to deny. Evelyn didn't expect to fall for the man she was paid to marry.

seasons.title: The Contract
seasons.description: How it all started with a single signature.

parts.text: She stared at the contract. One signature, and her life would no longer belong to her.
Mr. Sterling didn't look like a savior. He looked like a predator who had finally cornered his prey.
"Sign it, Evelyn," he said, his voice like velvet over gravel. "And your family's debt vanishes."
Her hand trembled as she gripped the pen. Was this freedom, or just a more gilded cage?
The penthouse was cold, despite the expensive heating. Or maybe it was just him.
He smiled like a man who had already won. But she had no idea he was hiding the bigger secret.
"There's only one rule in this house," he whispered, leaning close enough for her to smell his cologne. "Don't fall in love."
